queries.name: Messaging
queries.sql:
SELECT sender AS source, recipient AS target, weight
FROM demo.social.messages

queries.name: Team traffic
queries.sql:
SELECT a.team AS source, b.team AS target, sum(m.weight) AS weight
FROM demo.social.messages m
JOIN demo.social.people a ON a.id = m.sender
JOIN demo.social.people b ON b.id = m.recipient
GROUP BY a.team, b.team

graphs.name: Messaging
graphs.edges_sql:
SELECT sender AS source, recipient AS target, weight
FROM demo.social.messages
graphs.nodes_sql:
SELECT id, name AS label, team, city, joined
FROM demo.social.people

graphs.name: Team traffic
graphs.edges_sql:
SELECT a.team AS source, b.team AS target, sum(m.weight) AS weight
FROM demo.social.messages m
JOIN demo.social.people a ON a.id = m.sender
JOIN demo.social.people b ON b.id = m.recipient
GROUP BY a.team, b.team
graphs.nodes_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT team AS id, team AS label
FROM demo.social.people
